crops.title: Top of the page, whole viewport
crops.head: top-light-head.png

items.look_for: In the search button at the top right, "Search" and the key caps switch from the system font to Source Sans 3. The button is 5px narrower, and the nav links to its left move 5px right.
In the same search button, the "Search" label and the magnifier turn a lighter blue-gray (#4d4d4d to #636370).
The "v30.2" pill at the top of the right column gains a thin gray border.
In the middle column, body paragraphs stop at 480px instead of running the full 688px. The Note callout still spans the whole column.
Nothing to look for here.
items.note: No visible change by design. HEAD paragraphs measure exactly 480px, the fixed cap this commit sets. Its point is that the width holds during the font swap, which a settled screenshot cannot show. Leave it to a gate.

items.look_for: In the left sidebar, page links such as "Collections" and "Search" are regular weight instead of medium. They look lighter and a little shorter.
In the right column "On this page" list, "Action modes (create, upsert, update & emplace)" no longer leaves "emplace)" alone on its last line. It wraps into three even lines.

crops.note: Other differences in this frame come from shas shown in other crops. The Note callout title and its looser lines come from e69af439 and af36c9ea (see callouts). Inline code and links are a shade darker from 886ec9e6 (see L2 table-chip). The tab strip at the bottom edge comes from 11126d9b. Nothing unexplained.
